data.name: Nagendar
data.gender_notes: Nagendar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nagendra is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'naga' meaning serpent and 'andra' meaning man. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Naga, the king of serpents. Nagendra is believed to have the power to protect against venomous snakes and to bestow the blessings of good health and prosperity. The name Nagendar carries the meaning “Lord of the serpents” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nagendar usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the serpents and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine protection against venomous snakes and bestower of good health and prosperity.
data.etymology: Nagendar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the serpents.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nagendar total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nagendra has significant cultural relevance in Hindu mythology and is associated with the worship of the serpent god, Naga. This god is considered to be a protector against venomous snakes and is believed to bring good health, prosperity, and royal power. The name Nagendra reflects this cultural influence and resonates with the Hindu belief in the divine protection of the gods.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nagendra holds deep spiritual significance as it is derived from the Sanskrit words 'naga' and 'andra'. The name signifies the man who is infused with the divine power of the serpent god, Naga. This name conveys the spiritual quality of being protected by the divine and embodies the inner strength, wisdom, and royal power that comes from being in harmony with the universe and its divine beings. Nagendra is a name that inspires spiritual growth, self-confidence, and a deep connection with the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nagendra: Lord of Serpents. Embodiment of wisdom and mystical power, guardian of ancient knowledge and protector of the sacred.

historical_references.reference: Nagendra Kavi, a renowned poet and scholar of the Sanskrit language during the medieval period, wrote many poems on the Hindu deity, Nagaraja. His works are considered significant contributions to the Hindu literary tradition.

Another Nagendra, a Chola dynasty military commander during the 11th century, is mentioned in various inscriptions for his victories in wars against neighboring kingdoms. His military prowess is celebrated in Chola literature.
